$source_revision._note: Initial seed for issue #98. Values transcribed from the FLAG 2024 (Eur. Phys. J. C 84) report's N_f=2+1+1 averages. Adding more quantities is mechanical follow-up PRs.

m_pi_charged._note: FLAG quotes the PDG-experimental value for the pion mass directly as a fundamental input rather than as a lattice-derived quantity; this entry reproduces it for namespace completeness.

f_pi._note: FLAG 2024 N_f=2+1+1 average. Convention f_pi = 130.2(8) MeV (sqrt(2)*F_pi normalisation where F_pi ~ 92 MeV).

f_K_over_f_pi.description: Ratio of kaon to pion decay constants (better-known than either separately due to cancellation of systematics)

g_A.description: Nucleon axial-vector charge from lattice QCD
g_A._note: FLAG 2024 N_f=2+1+1 average. The experimental value from neutron beta decay is g_A = 1.2754(13), so the lattice value sits within 1 sigma of experiment but with substantially larger uncertainty — both are reported here for verification consumers; experimental value lives in nuclear.* namespace.

sigma_piN.description: Pion-nucleon sigma term (light-quark contribution to nucleon mass)
sigma_piN._note: FLAG 2024 N_f=2+1+1 lattice value. Disagrees with the phenomenological (pionic-atom) extraction (~59 MeV) at marginal significance; reflective of an ongoing tension in the hadronic-input community.
